title: Engineering Delivery Report
description: DC-003-I029 — one completed engineering task, authored by the Delivery Office. Replaces an informal markdown delivery summary with a structured, permanent repository object. Captures engineering EVIDENCE only (test/fixture counts, files touched, commit/push/working-tree state, repository findings) — never conversational text, never a transcript, never a prompt. `status` reuses `finished-carousel.schema.json`'s own `carousel_overall_statuses` vocabulary (completed/partial/failed) rather than inventing a parallel one.

work_order_id.description: The Engineering Work Order this delivery answers. Referential integrity is a store/service-layer concern, not enforced by this schema.

status.description: completed: every review criterion was met. partial: some, not all. failed: the task did not deliver. This is the DELIVERY's own claim about itself — it is never 'approved' (Strategy Office review is separate, external evidence this object does not carry — see README 'Status Model').

commit.description: The commit this delivery produced. Null only for a 'failed' delivery that produced no commit.

repository_findings.description: What the required repository investigation actually found — genuine gaps, reused patterns, confirmed non-duplication. Not a narrative — one finding per entry.

compatibility.description: Modules/milestones explicitly confirmed unchanged by this delivery, e.g. "I008-I012 unchanged".
